issues.description: The script sends latitude and longitude coordinates to nominatim.openstreetmap.org for reverse geocoding using GM_xmlhttpRequest.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive, non-personal data is sent. Inform users about this external request.

issues.description: The script is designed to send map pin data to Discord (discord.com) via webhook or API (as indicated by @connect and feature description).
issues.recommendation: Ensure no sensitive or personal user data is sent. Make this behavior opt-in and clearly inform users.

issues.description: The script requests Notification API permission and can send browser notifications.
issues.recommendation: Only use Notification API with clear user consent and avoid spamming notifications.

issues.description: The script applies Proxy wrappers to native prototypes (e.g., setAttribute, push, setItem, fetch) which may break page functionality or introduce unexpected behavior.
issues.recommendation: Limit prototype modifications to only what is strictly necessary and document all changes.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which allows arbitrary cross-origin requests.
issues.recommendation: Limit usage to only required domains and document all external requests.

issues.description: The script requests @connect for discord.com and nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which are third-party services.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary domains are listed and inform users about all external connections.

summary: This script transmits map coordinates to external services (nominatim.openstreetmap.org for reverse geocoding and discord.com for sharing pins), which constitutes critical data exfiltration and privacy risk. It also requests notification permissions and modifies native prototypes, which may impact page stability. No code obfuscation or DOM XSS risks were detected. The script should be considered high risk unless all data transmissions are made fully transparent and strictly limited to non-sensitive information.
